sections.teacherNotes:
Teacher transcript:
Hello! My name is Leo. I look outside. I see the sun. It is a nice day. I want to go for a walk. First, I put on my shirt. My shirt is green. I like my green shirt. Next, I put on my shoes. My shoes are brown. I put one shoe on each foot. Now I look for my hat. Where is my hat? Here it is! My hat is yellow. I put it on my head. The hat gives my head some shade.

I walk with my mom. We see a small bird. We stop and look at the bird. Then we look up. We see clouds. Now we see rain. We go inside. My yellow hat is a sun hat. It does not keep the rain away. We sit together and wait. I take off my shoes. I put my hat on a chair. After a little time, the rain stops. I look outside again. I can see the sun! I smile at my mom. We can take our walk now.

Read the questions aloud for young learners. Replay or reread in short sections if needed.
